feature_contract.goal: Keep car-selection and other front-end indexed DDS art bound to the correct UI xstset across scene xmtset loads and reused mutable game filename buffers; preserve original texture decode/rollback and object-order semantics.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the original xstset/xmtset filename-to-indexed DDS selection and stream counters; unchanged DDS bytes, texture decoding, FFB, SkyGlow, host, R84 stereo and R26_SAFE fallback.
trace_stages: Original UI LoadXstsetSprite and stage LoadXmtsetObject announce the current pack; the original engine may reuse char* storage and xstset slots.

HandleTexture combines per-pack ordinal with DDS hash/dimensions to select indexed replacement filename; previously both streams incremented CurrentTextureIdx and scene changed pack only on pointer inequality.
Independent value-snapshotted pack cursors bind indexed DDS names to their own stream before D3DX fast/native decoder and R84 game/UI stereo composition.
subcomponents: Decouple scene XMT sequential DDS ordinal from UI XST/vehicle-selection ordinal.
Detect reused mutable scene filename buffers by copying path contents and switch UI pack upon xstset slot change even with same name.
Keep xmt object index from resetting the scene pack and preserve original fast/native DDS fallback, RGB alpha, UI scaling and selected car art.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Vehicle-select XST art and interleaved stage XMT DDS source
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: UI and scene independently start index zero per changed pack; same pack resumes sequential indexed DDS; same char* overwritten with different path rebinds scene.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: D3DX fast/native fallback, GUI/scene old source and per-slot UI scaling
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original decoder/rollback untouched, same xmt object pack does not reset on XmtIndex change, malformed/no-name pack does not leak into new selection.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Active Win32, R26_SAFE, x64 host, package/Domain/affected Inspector and Full Source
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Existing exact-SHA GitHub Actions Gate success at validation-bearing source/result commit; Quest3 run remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: LoadXstsetSprite_dest and LoadXmtsetObject_dest both reset one shared CurrentTextureIdx; HandleTexture increments it regardless of isUITexture; scene PrevXmtName compares two char* addresses, not path content. XMT index belongs to objects, XST eax is an xstset slot.
diagnosis.root_cause: Indexed filename sequence crossed UI/scene pack boundaries and mutable scene file path buffer reuse could skip pack reset; existing path identity was not a durable value.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change D3DX texture loader, mutate replacement DDS or reset scene sequence for every XmtIndex object. Preserve original fallback.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Independent value-snapshotted C++ cursors and source-bound ordinal selection; targeted mutated regression verifier.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Five source contract mutations cover shared-index leak, scene object-index reset, UI slot alias, pointer identity and off-by-one ordinal reset.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Texture binding remains original game D3D9; R84 stereo render path unchanged.
